deviations.reason: GoogleOAuthProvider/AuthProvider only when features.auth is google. A 401 re-probes EscapeVelocity backend sessions and checks the app's own session before raising AUTH_EXPIRED_EVENT, so an EV backend's 401 never signs the user out of the app.
